rationale: Lydia brings deep expertise in developer experience and agentic AI tooling (Claude Code at Anthropic), while John is operationalizing AI infrastructure at scale across cloud platforms and leading developer communities. They share a conviction that agentic AI represents a fundamental shift in how engineers work, and can explore how DX strategy unlocks adoption of autonomous coding tools in enterprise cloud environments.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet John Komarnicki — you both see agentic AI as the real inflection point, and can compare notes on how great developer tooling communication and operational infrastructure make that shift possible.
